description: Apply a relation's auto-link rules to the records that already exist, and return a summary of what got linked. It pays for itself after an import: create_records writes 100 rows in one call and this links them in one more, replacing a hundred link_records calls. Needs a rule to be set (set_auto_link).

relation.description: The relation FIELD on this database (name or api_name), or a relation id.

name: run_auto_link
title: Run auto-link
